idea-plugin.name: Vue Routes
idea-plugin.description:
See every Vue Router route in your project at a glance.

Vue Routes scans JavaScript and TypeScript router configuration files, flattens nested children, resolves lazy component imports, and displays the result in a searchable tool window. Type or paste a route path (/dashboard/employees), a full URL, a route name, or a component name; results are ranked by relevance, with exact paths first. Double-click a route to jump to its definition, or open its Vue component directly. Right-click a route to open the layout component declared by its closest parent route.

Supports Vue Router 4 (createRouter), Vue Router 3 (new VueRouter), typed RouteRecordRaw[] arrays, named and lazy component imports, tsconfig/jsconfig path aliases, and the conventional @/ and ~/ aliases.
